case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the centrally located property, attentive and friendly staff, plentiful breakfast, cleanliness, and spacious, tastefully decorated rooms (several mention balconies and large bathrooms). A few guests reported minor issues—air conditioning, lack of wardrobe, pillow comfort, and an untidy outside/garden—each appearing as isolated comments rather than widespread complaints. Overall feedback combines consistent positives with occasional individual negatives.
